cards.card_text: In the dream, they're all binding sheaves of grain in a field.
cards.verse_text: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to mine.”
cards.snippet: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood…

cards.card_text: What do his brothers' sheaves do?

cards.card_text: The foreman says Ruth asked to glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.
cards.verse_text: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out and has continued from morning until now, except that she rested a short time in the shelter.”
cards.snippet: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out and has continued from morning…

cards.card_text: Boaz tells his young men they may insult Ruth if she gathers among the sheaves.
cards.verse_text: When Ruth got up to glean, Boaz ordered his young men, “Even if she gathers among the sheaves, do not insult her.
cards.snippet: …glean, Boaz ordered his young men, “Even if she gathers among the sheaves, do not insult her.

cards.card_text: The poor carry the sheaves, crush the olives and tread the winepresses.
cards.verse_text: They carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.
cards.snippet: They carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.

cards.card_text: Sheaves of grain A basket of figs A jar of oil
cards.verse_text: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
cards.snippet: …a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.

cards.card_text: Nothing to fill the reaper's hands, nothing for the arms of the binder of sheaves.
cards.verse_text: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
cards.snippet: …the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.

cards.card_text: Here's the twist: the LORD has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
cards.verse_text: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD or understand His plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
cards.snippet: …the LORD or understand His plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among the sheaves.
cards.verse_text: On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among the sheaves; they will consume all the peoples around them on the right and on the left, while the people of Jerusalem remain secure there.
